g.text: ADNI 1–7: frozen sample-level validation (three training seeds)
A0: BrainPrompt | A1: P2 | A2: P3 | A3: P5 | A4: P2+P3 | A5: P2+P5 | A6: P3+P5 | A7: all
Dots: training seeds; error bars: sample SD, not patient confidence intervals. TEST not used.
